title: joule operator SOP
purpose: Day-to-day operation of a joule mesh lab and future public pool gateway.
scope: Operators running joule coordinators, donor agents, and release gates for f00-sh/joule.

sections.heading: Purpose
sections.body: This SOP defines how operators run joule safely: mesh lab checks, contribution gates, and release documentation. Graphical flowcharts are mandatory for gate and ship flows.

sections.heading: Day-to-day gates
sections.body: Before exposing any gateway: (1) cargo test green, (2) joule lab succeeds, (3) ledger mint/burn demo succeeds, (4) no freeloader path without contribution checks when API is enabled.

sections.heading: Release ship flow
sections.body: Ship only via house release workflow: tests green, CHANGELOG, file_id.diz, README/Pages/man sync, SOP PDF, release memo PDF, tag, attach assets.
